text:
Nora: quick summary from TidalBay onboarding call this morning — they surfaced 4 product asks and one renewal concern. dropping raw highlights here.
Cal: can you bullet the top items so we can triage quickly?
Nora: TL;DR: 1) product-search embeddings often return vendor/display names but omit canonical SKU tokens (breaks their downstream mapping). 2) docs/examples about per-route billing are ambiguous — customer believed quota was account-global. 3) they want team-level quotas plus an approval workflow (admin UI + audit trail + email approvals). 4) Console onboarding checklist missing steps for assigning quota owners. Also a small SDK mismatch: docs example uses `quota_limit` but SDK expects `limit`.
Jin: for #1 any minimal repro we can paste (query + response)?
Nora: pasted snippet + transcript link: https://app.redwood/meetings/tidalbay-2026-08-02/transcript 
Nora: ```
query: "lookup sku for OceanGrip 12"
response: "OceanGrip 12 by WaveParts"  // expected response includes token like SKU-OG12-047
```
Harper: marking as renewal-watch. CSM said TidalBay's QBR in 7 weeks and search reliability + admin controls influence expansion. tagging `renewal-watch`.
Cal: assigning owners — @Jin can you try to reproduce today and scope whether it's prompt/preproc vs model output distribution?
Jin: will repro today. if it's a normalization/prompt issue we can patch in ~3 business days; if it's model output behavior might need prompt tuning or a model variant (longer).
Nora: docs param rename is trivial, I can open a PR to change `quota_limit` -> `limit` and clarify per-route vs account quota examples.
Cal: regarding team quotas + approval workflow, product: is the immediate ask just per-team ceilings or also the multi-step approvals?
Nora: they specifically want: a) team ceilings, b) ability to propose an increase that triggers an approver email, c) audit trail showing who approved + timestamp. They'd use the proposal flow during onboarding for new teams.
Harper: product note — this is a common enterprise ask. may be P1 for this customer because it blocks role delegation.
Cal: action items: 1) Jin triage SKU mapping (owner: Jin) 2) Nora docs PR for quota examples (owner: Nora) 3) create backlog item for team quotas + approval workflow + audit logs (owner: Cal) 4) Harper to handle renewal comms with CSM and offer interim workaround.
Nora: created FEED-20333 and attached call notes: https://app.redwood/feedback/FEED-20333 — please add labels `onboarding`, `search`, `rbac`, `billing` and estimates.
feedback-bot: FEED-20333 created and linked to customer TidalBay. Priority: P2.
Harper: interim workaround suggestion: grant one user quota-admin role, use prompt hints to include SKU tokens, and add a small post-process regex extractor (we gave them an example). I'll email the template.
Cal: can we aim for a docs canary today and a triage update by EOD tomorrow?
Jin: repro in progress, will update FEED-20333 with repro steps and paste test logs here once done.
Nora: thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll coordinate a short sync with the CSM if Jin's repro surfaces actionable fixes before the QBR.
